name: Milford
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Milford, MI: the Christmas parade, seven Santa visits downtown and MI Bright Lights, a drive through show at Camp Dearborn.
lede: Milford's Christmas starts the Saturday after Thanksgiving with a downtown parade, adds seven Santa visits through December and ends with a drive through light show at Camp Dearborn.
celebrates: The Milford Christmas Parade marches down Main Street on the Saturday after Thanksgiving, sponsored by the Huron Valley Chamber of Commerce. Santa then visits downtown on seven dates between November 28 and December 19, mostly at Village Center Mall and once at the Center Street Gazebo. At Camp Dearborn, MI Bright Lights is a drive through holiday show that runs nightly from November 13 to December 30, with drone show nights on four dates. Together they give Milford families a parade, a Santa and a light show. Highland, folded into this page, holds its Tree Lighting and Kris Kringle Market on December 7 with a kids' choir, Santa photos and horse drawn wagon rides.
lastyear: Last year the Milford Christmas Parade ran on Saturday, November 29, 2025, at 10 am, when the Village of Milford's Facebook page promised festive floats, marching bands and Santa Claus. The village's downtown events pages also list the parade as an annual event sponsored every year by the Huron Valley Chamber of Commerce, held on the Saturday after Thanksgiving, so families can count on the same weekend and the same Main Street route each year.
facts: The parade is a traditional downtown event that the Chamber of Commerce has sponsored every year, according to Milford's downtown events page. It always falls on the Saturday after Thanksgiving. Camp Dearborn, where MI Bright Lights is held, is at 1700 General Motors Road in Milford. MI Bright Lights charges per vehicle, $25 online or $30 at the gate, and drone show nights are $35.
traditions: A Main Street parade the Saturday after Thanksgiving, sponsored by the Huron Valley Chamber.

faq: With a Main Street Christmas parade on the Saturday after Thanksgiving, seven Santa visits in downtown Milford through December 19 and MI Bright Lights, a drive through light show at Camp Dearborn that runs nightly until December 30. Together they give families a parade, a Santa visit and a light show within one month.
When is the Milford Christmas Parade?

Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 10 am to noon on Main Street, sponsored by the Huron Valley Chamber of Commerce. Public parades are free to watch, so there is no ticket. Santa visits downtown after the parade from 11 am to 1 pm, so you can follow the floats with a quick stop to meet him.
When can kids visit Santa in Milford?

On November 28, December 3, 5, 10, 12, 17 and 19, 2026. Weekday visits are 5 to 7 pm and Saturday visits are 11 am to 1 pm, except December 5, which is 4 to 7 pm at the Center Street Gazebo. Most visits are at Village Center Mall, 400 N Main St, and the village page does not print a price.
How much is MI Bright Lights?

$25 per vehicle online or $30 at the gate. Drone show nights on November 25 and December 2, 9 and 16 cost $35 per vehicle, and the ticket page shows $37.51 with fees. The show is open nightly from 6 to 10 pm from November 13 to December 30, so buy online to save $5.
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Milford, MI 2026
trains: Amtrak's Wolverine route serves Royal Oak and Troy, the closest stations for Oakland County families. For a holiday train at a smaller scale, the Rochester Hills Museum at Van Hoosen Farm hosts the All Aboard model railroad exhibit, built by the Stoney Creek Model Railroad Club, on 13 dates from November 27 to December 30, 2026, with trains running noon to 3 pm. Rally also keeps a statewide guide to Michigan Christmas train rides for longer trips.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Milford for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, including the free Christmas parade. The magic runs from November 28 (Milford Christmas Parade) through December 30 (MI Bright Lights at Camp Dearborn), with Santa visits downtown on seven dates and the Highland Tree Lighting and Kris Kringle Market on December 7 along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Milford

  • Meet Santa: seven downtown visits, November 28 to December 19, and Santa photos at the Highland tree lighting
  • Lights: MI Bright Lights, November 13 to December 30
  • Tree lighting: Highland Tree Lighting and Kris Kringle Market, December 7 (Highland folded into Milford)
  • Season: November 13 to December 30
